description: Update a kept (permanent) DevGlow project's metadata. Pass only the fields you want to change. Does NOT apply to temporary AI processes — for those, set fields at run_process time or have the user keep the process first.

description.description: What the app does, plus any notes worth keeping (max 1000 chars). Appending to what is already there is usually right — read it with get_project first rather than overwriting. Pass null or empty string to clear.

id.description: Project id (call list_projects first). Must be a permanent project, not an AI process (those have ids starting with 'ai-').

interactive.description: Toggle PTY (interactive terminal) mode. true = run through a pseudo-terminal so tools like flutter run / expo start accept hot reload (r) / restart (R) keys; false = plain pipe. Only set when the user explicitly asks to change it.

port.description: New port number. Pass null to clear the existing port.

tags.description: Tags as a list of strings. Pass [] to clear. Do NOT invent tags; only set this when the user explicitly asks, or when reusing an existing tag visible in list_projects.

name: update_project
title: Update a project's metadata
